text:
alice: Heads up — release window tonight 21:00 UTC. Deploybot will run tf apply for vpc/net + iam. Need final thumbs on provider pin and rollback plan.
ben: confirming I can be on-call for the apply. +1 to provider pin. which version?
alice: pinning hash to registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/aws 4.12.1 (we tested this in staging). I pushed the PR with the lockfile: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1245 :rocket:
carol: quick note — the module that manages tgws has a subtle route change. I added a dry-run output to the PR comments. please scan for host-route deletions.
dan: suggest we run a single-az serial apply first (staging -> canary prod AZ) then expand. avoids churn.
infra-oncall: please add me to the escalation list. i'll monitor CloudWatch + VPC flow logs during the window. set Alert:net.iface.drop to critical.
deploybot: [bot] Scheduled tf apply for 2025-03-01T21:00:00Z by @alice. Mode: serial-apply. Canary: 10%. Holdback: 5 minutes between AZs. Rollback script: /ops/run-rollback.sh attached.
alice: deploybot config looks good. two asks: (1) ensure rollback disables route-injection in the module before destroy, (2) smoke test endpoint /healthz on each AZ after the canary step.
ben: acknowledged. i added this smoke test to the runbook and the steps to validate IAM perms (sts:AssumeRole check).
carol: pasted the small snippet we ran in staging:
```bash
# sanity check
curl -s -S -f https://edge-staging-us-west-2.redwood.ai/healthz || exit 1
```
carol: also noting terraform plan has one replace for module.tgw.aws_route.main (route rewrite) — not a full replacement, just handles next-hop update.
dan: if the route replace fails, fallback plan: pin previous route with a provider alias and block traffic to the new route with a temporary route-table override. Ops runbook has commands.
infra-oncall: added CloudTrail watch and a short lambda to revoke newly inserted routes if they appear malformed. will remove after stability check.
alice: final preflight checklist: PR merged, provider pinned, deploybot scheduled (serial), smoke test in runbook, oncall + ben monitoring, rollback script staged. anything else?
ben: release notes: i put a short blurb in the release-notes repo and linked the PR.
dan: tagging @security for the IAM role change signoff? small perms change for service account.
alice: done. @security please ack by 20:30 UTC or we proceed with weekend-safe flag.
deploybot: [bot] Reminder: manual confirmation required at canary step. react :thumbsup: to approve canary.
carol: LGTM. i'll be watching the canary metrics and can manually abort if QPS drops > 5% or error rate > 1%.
ben: ping once canary completes and before rolling to remaining AZs.
alice: thanks team — see you in the window. if anyone needs the escape hatch: /ops/run-rollback.sh --fast-exit
